run_fairseq_train: run fairseq-train to train a sequence-to-sequence model on a dataset
run_fairseq_generate: run fairseq-generate to generate translations or sequences from a trained model
run_fairseq_eval_lm: run fairseq-eval-lm to evaluate a language model on a test set
run_fairseq_preprocess: run fairseq-preprocess to preprocess and binarize training data for fairseq
run_fairseq_interactive: run fairseq-interactive to interactively generate sequences from a trained model
